assets.name: rex-cinematic-wide
assets.prompt: Original promotional cinematic action illustration for Primal Echo in refined crisp PIXEL ART. Image1 is a reference ONLY for cinematic framing, natural daylight, grounded action staging and camera angle; do NOT copy its woman, costume, machine species, weapons or setting details. Image2 is the binding design reference for Rex; Image3 is the binding design reference for Kael. Compose a tense encounter at human eye level / slightly low angle: Kael in left foreground, three-quarter side view, athletic braced stance on a mossy broken platform, actively drawing his simple bow and looking toward Rex. Kael is a teenage boy with tousled brown hair, orange shirt, brown backpack, cyan wrist bracelet; his spear is strapped to his pack, no extra limbs. Rex approaches from right midground in a believable heavy forward stride, about 3 times Kael's standing height, NOT a mountain-sized monster. Rex's proportions are lean and functional, faithful to reference2: narrow long dinosaur head, off-white manufactured armor plates over dark mechanical skeleton, orange cable routes and triangular shoulder emblem, compact rectangular dorsal power module with cyan square light grid and thin curved antenna cables, tapering armored tail and small forearms, normal digitigrade legs. No enlarged skull, huge shoulder pads, oversized gun, exaggerated teeth or extra weaponry. Clear visual separation between character and machine, camera shows both fully and coherently. Sunlit abandoned technological jungle, soft blue sky openings, restrained natural greens and stone, backlit foliage, small dust particles and atmospheric perspective, cyan lights subtle not washing scene blue. Diagonal composition and layered foreground roots imply imminent movement. Restrained proportions, cinematic storytelling, NOT a static side-on character lineup. Authentic deliberate square pixel clusters and stepped contours at roughly640x360 game-art logic; no smooth 3D render, no giant glowing portal, no horror caricature. No text or logos. Horizontal widescreen16:9; full Rex including head, antennae, tail and feet comfortably within frame. Left third dark shaded foreground foliage can support small website text.
